result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my top recommendation is **Stripe**, unless you're already using Shopify — in which case I'd choose **Shopify Payments**\.

The best option depends on your ecommerce platform, where your customers are located, and how much you sell.

Assuming you're operating in Australia, here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best payment processors for a small Australian online store

![Expert Pricing – Tutora](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/s215eOkCrBJePJ6aedIAPORR2dSQKpg4r3kdjo_wlgJnHkyQ2l5DLHu9GE6cuq7DyIdsT5AkGFo_O1lteac7Hs-JP8Zcc66y70mgHCRBP4oIOblvA2wYsTXPnCEklYN9pAD0oC9n8Sn7qYbRw4Qg_jr4Bc3IEn5KMxhAijD_r0bRoq8DtkAmGOw6J64vSDi0?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Australian domestic cards: approximately 1.65% + \$0.30
- No monthly fee on standard pricing
- Excellent fraud protection and reporting
- Integrates with WooCommerce, Wix and many other platforms

Best for flexibility and growing online businesses.

[Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au) · [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Domestic card rates from 1.75% + \$0.30 on Basic
- Built directly into Shopify
- Easy refunds, reporting and reconciliation
- Avoids additional third-party transaction fees

My first choice if your store runs on Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments) · [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Airwallex enters South Korean market with Paynuri acquisition](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D_4VHtA0SeOgicDFzw011KJjQsOKBcSueMkln4sAfXodLPEEa3t7NtMxla-fIF5UWu0iXuS_YfYtmjw0S_rQ80_HadZtbc68lQEKKReC4CqTEUwGZOTEsoS2QB_Jg1eQrkNfUqjqLxuL1E_IdkYV3XpPRgzm363kqM09FHLONA7S51LtpUhmis0bGr00iqMt?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Airwallex**

(Best for international sales)

- Domestic cards: approximately 1.65% + \$0.30
- International payment support
- Multi-currency accounts
- Useful accounting integrations

Particularly attractive if you sell overseas.

[Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au) · [stripe.com](https://stripe.com/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.shopify.com](https://www.shopify.com/au/pricing?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers
- Offers PayPal checkout and card payments
- Easy to add to most ecommerce platforms
- Generally more expensive than Stripe for domestic cards

I'd use it as an additional payment option rather than my only processor.

[PayPal Business Australia](https://www.paypal.com/au/business) · [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[zapier.com](https://zapier.com/blog/best-payment-gateways/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

*Fees are indicative published rates, not quotes. Check current eligibility, card types and additional charges before signing up.*

## My recommendation

For a small store starting out\:

- Shopify store: Shopify Payments + PayPal.
- WooCommerce store: Stripe + PayPal.
- International customers: consider Airwallex alongside Stripe.
